messages.risk.directory.summary: Record the risks in a project, see them by status, and review them when due.
messages.risk.empty.body: Record what could go wrong and see it by impact and likelihood.
messages.risk.empty.title: No risks yet
messages.risk.error.failed: That did not work. Try again shortly.
messages.risk.error.no-answer: No answer came back. Check the connection and try again.
messages.risk.field.title: Title
messages.risk.form.required: Title and description are both needed
messages.risk.form.statement-hint: When it would happen, and what follows if it does
messages.risk.form.title-hint: In one line, what could go wrong
messages.risk.form.treatment-hint: How you plan to reduce, transfer or accept it
messages.risk.grid.label: Impact {impact}, likelihood {likelihood}
messages.risk.overview.failed-body: This does not mean there are none. Try again shortly.
messages.risk.overview.no-match-body: Change the filters, or clear them to see all.
messages.risk.overview.title: Project risks
messages.risk.record.closed-body: Closed {when}. Reopen it to keep following up.
messages.risk.record.conflict: This risk was just changed elsewhere
messages.risk.record.conflict-body: Compare them: keep the current version, or continue your changes on top of it.
messages.risk.record.read-only-body: You cannot change risks in this project.
messages.risk.record.standalone: This risk stands on its own; you can also link it to the Goals it affects.
messages.risk.review.failed: The last round did not finish
messages.risk.review.focus-hint: Leave empty to look at the whole risk
messages.risk.review.left: The risk is closed, but its review could not be cancelled. Cancel it in Schedule.
messages.risk.review.no-reads: The review cannot read this risk yet
messages.risk.review.no-reads-body: When it is due, it reads only what you granted this task. Grant it reading in Schedule.
messages.risk.review.no-result: The last round left no finding.
messages.risk.review.none: No review scheduled. When it is due, the background assistant looks at it once and suggests; it never changes this risk itself.
messages.risk.review.none-closed: The risk is closed; no more reviews.
messages.risk.review.reads-attention-body: A grant is waiting for you or no longer available, so the review may not read this risk.
messages.risk.review.reads-ok: Reading is granted; the review can read this risk when it is due.
messages.risk.review.reads-unknown: Cannot tell what this review may read right now.
messages.risk.review.title: Review
messages.risk.review.unavailable-body: Reviews are scheduled by Schedule; this project does not have Schedule on, or you cannot reach it.
messages.risk.side.idle-body: Open a risk from a Goal, the Assistant or search and it shows here first.
